name: GoAnyAPI
tagline: Access SEO and marketing data APIs with one key and shared credits.
description:
GoAnyAPI is a developer platform for SEO and marketing data APIs. Use one API key and a shared credit balance for traffic, ranking, backlinks, keyword research, Google and Bing SERP, Trends, and advertising research, plus MCP and CLI.

Watch out: this is a credit-priced data API. The public llms.txt, read 2026-11-14, says it includes AI search and answer collection, Google AI Overview and AI Mode, ChatGPT and Gemini scrapers, and an MCP server at mcp.goanyapi.com/mcp. The footer says it is not affiliated with Google.
